desc: Read input N, M and the edges, building an adjacency list for the graph.
Use BFS or DFS to traverse the graph, identifying connected components and performing bipartite coloring (two-coloring) to count the number of nodes in each of the two partitions for every component.
For each connected component, compute the product of the sizes of its two partitions and sum these products across all components to get the maximum possible edges in a maximal bipartite graph.
Calculate the total moves as `(sum of a_k * b_k) - M`.
If the total moves is odd, print "Aoki"; otherwise, print "Takahashi".
